fact: The RNPP (Registre national des personnes physiques) holds citizens' biometric and civil data and assigns each a national identification number (NNI), with 11 million people holding one according to the ONECI director-general as relayed by the article.

BCPFS and ONECI signed a convention on 2 April 2026 interconnecting the Registre Social Unique with ONECI's databases, so beneficiaries are identified through the Registre National des Personnes Physiques run by ONECI.

ONECI, under the Interior Ministry, is described as managing the RNPP and assigning the national identification number, which is the basis the PARAE feasibility study launched on 5 October 2026 builds on.
